title: eMMC host: RST_n pulse and power-up, CMD0 / CMD1 (busy polling) / CMD2 / CMD3 / CMD7 initialisation, then repeated CMD24 write and CMD17 read-back compare rounds in 1-bit mode, with R1 / R2 / R3 framing, CRC7, card-status, CRC16, CRC status token, busy and timeout checks

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a response, CRC status, busy or read phase failed (framing, CRC7, command index, card-status error bits, timeout, negative or missing CRC status, busy timeout, read CRC16 / end bit / compare); the host retries

notes: The core runs on PCLK and drives the device: emmc_clk (CLK) is PCLK / ID_CLK_DIV (128: at most 400 kHz for PCLK up to 51.2 MHz) during identification and PCLK / CLK_DIV (2) from CMD7 on; emmc_rst_n (RST_n) is an output, held low RST_LOW PCLK cycles after PRESETN and then high RST_WAIT cycles (tRSCA) before the 74 power-up clocks and CMD0. cmd and dat[7:0] (bidirectional, need pull-ups; only DAT0 is used) pass through unchanged; CMD / DAT0 change on the CLK falling edge and are sampled on the rising edge. Responses are looked for from N_CR = 2 to 64 clocks; read access and write busy have their own limits, RD_TIMEOUT and BUSY_TIMEOUT CLK cycles (defaults 100 ms and 250 ms at 26 MHz). CMD7 selects the device (RCA 1) before any transfer. The host initialises the device and runs its write / read-back rounds on its own.
Blocks are 32 bytes (the slice's simplification of 512).
